title: Polynomial-time computability of the run
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over bits and natural numbers $c,B,e$, the function mapping a bit string to the result of the associated dynamic-programming run is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over bits
